title: Length of padded circuit advice
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic circuits, let $A:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be a length bound, and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$. If the encoding of the circuit $C(n)$ has length at least one less than $A(n)$, then the padded advice string for $C$, $A$, and $n$ has length exactly $A(n)$.
hypotheses_covered: A family $C$ of directed acyclic circuits
The encoding length of $C(n)$ plus $1$ is at most $A(n)$
